layout: Line 1 (Бенефисъ г-жи Никулиной.) = heading: set in a heavier sans-serif/bold face unlike the work lines, centred, sits inside this one Малый cell only (not a banner across theaters). Lines 2-4 ordinary.
note: Moscow, Малый театръ, 22 Понед. (22 февраля 1899, p.31); receipts 3327 р. — к. omitted. Genre on line 3 printed «др. эск.» (as read; ‹эск.› with an unusual first letter shape, possibly a broken э). Letter-level: Ложь ends ь, Ноктюрнъ ends ъ.

layout: Line 1 (Въ пользу инвалидовъ.) = heading: no genre, centred, set in the bolder/larger face (a benefit-for-the-invalids heading); inside this one Большой cell only. The Alexandrinsky cell of the same day has its own similar «Въ пользу инвалидовъ.» line, so it is repeated per cell, not a single spanning banner. Line 2 ordinary.
